description: This file contains tests for diagnostic session state management, including pruning, session state reuse, and diagnostic thresholds, utilizing vi test framework and mocking filesystem and timers.

methods.name: getDiagnosticSessionState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a diagnostic session state by session ID and optional session key.

methods.name: getDiagnosticSessionStateCountForTest
methods.description: Returns the current count of tracked diagnostic session states for testing purposes.

methods.name: pruneDiagnosticSessionStates
methods.description: Removes stale or excess diagnostic session states based on time and count thresholds.

methods.name: resetDiagnosticSessionStateForTest
methods.description: Resets session state tracking to initial state for testing.

methods.name: onDiagnosticEvent
methods.description: Registers a callback to handle diagnostic events like session stuck notifications.

methods.name: startDiagnosticHeartbeat
methods.description: Starts periodic diagnostics checking, with configuration options for thresholds and enabling.

methods.name: logSessionStateChange
methods.description: Logs a change in session state with session ID, key, and new state.

methods.name: resetDiagnosticStateForTest
methods.description: Resets diagnostic internal state for testing purposes.

methods.name: resolveStuckSessionWarnMs
methods.description: Determines the threshold for considering a session as stuck, based on configuration or defaults.
